workflow_metadata.description: Inject complete reflow toolchain into developed system's context folder for standalone operation
workflow_metadata.purpose: Transform developed systems into standalone repositories containing all reflow workflow capabilities within their context folder
workflow_metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial implementation of self-contained system injection
workflow_metadata.IMPORTANT: This workflow injects the entire reflow decision-making and development process into the target system, making it completely self-contained
workflow_metadata.usage_pattern: Run from reflow directory on existing developed system to make it standalone
benefits: Developed systems become completely standalone with embedded workflow tools
Each system can be pushed to its own GitHub repo with full reflow capabilities
No dependency on external reflow installation
Systems contain complete development workflow within their context folder
Optional cleanup removes workflow artifacts for production delivery

injection_philosophy.description: Transform the developed system into a self-contained workflow environment
injection_philosophy.approach: The context folder becomes a complete reflow environment embedded within the system

after_injection: ├── context/          # Now contains COMPLETE reflow environment
│   ├── workflows/    # Full decision_flow.json + all workflow JSONs
│   └── inject_flow.json  # This workflow file for reference

self_contained_benefits: System repo contains everything needed to continue development with reflow
Team can clone system repo and immediately use full reflow capabilities
No need to install or maintain separate reflow repository
Complete development history and context preserved within system
System becomes a showcase of reflow methodology

required_artifacts: Target system must exist with standard reflow directory structure
System must have completed at least initial architecture (context/ folder exists)
specs/, services/, docs/ directories should be present
verification.working_directory: Must be run from reflow root directory

tool.creates_if_missing: Tools will create the injection readiness validator
tool.success_criteria: Target system has basic reflow structure and is suitable for injection
